review_kind: Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5) of the UI audit's new and corrected captions: the Annotate toolbar groups and Setup menu, Make Masks Keep and its menu, the organism Planned caption, the Make Masks masthead, the Cellpose Workbench tab help, the settings level switch and Templates, the vendor AI account lines, Per-core and the default instruction. No native-speaker sign-off.

records.key: Accept proposals without clicking. Region mode follows Objects added; Whole image accepts only the object under the pointer. Undo is available; Keep, or moving to another image with Save on navigation on, writes the masks.
records.source: Accept proposals without clicking. Region mode follows Objects added; Whole image accepts only the object under the pointer. Undo is available; Keep, or moving to another image with Save on navigation on, writes the masks.
records.translation: Accepter les propositions sans cliquer. Le mode Région suit Objets ajoutés ; Image entière n’accepte que l’objet situé sous le pointeur. Annuler est disponible ; Conserver, ou le passage à une autre image lorsque Enregistrer en naviguant est activé, écrit les masques.

records.key: Add the outline micro-SAM drew as one new object: one edit, undone by one Ctrl+Z, written by Keep and recorded in the field's curation ledger with the prompt, the model and the micro-SAM version. Enter on the image does the same. Default unavailable until an outline is shown.
records.source: Add the outline micro-SAM drew as one new object: one edit, undone by one Ctrl+Z, written by Keep and recorded in the field's curation ledger with the prompt, the model and the micro-SAM version. Enter on the image does the same. Default unavailable until an outline is shown.
records.translation: Ajoute le contour tracé par micro-SAM comme un nouvel objet : une modification, annulée par un seul Ctrl+Z, écrite par Conserver et consignée dans le journal de curation du champ avec l’invite, le modèle et la version de micro-SAM. Entrée sur l’image fait de même. Indisponible par défaut tant qu’aucun contour n’est affiché.

records.key: Choose the parent-mask folder above. Use whole-image Replace, then Keep. Centre measurements are saved beside the mask; shared centre pixels have one label owner. Min area is bypassed.
records.source: Choose the parent-mask folder above. Use whole-image Replace, then Keep. Centre measurements are saved beside the mask; shared centre pixels have one label owner. Min area is bypassed.
records.translation: Sélectionnez ci-dessus le dossier des masques parents. Utilisez Replace sur toute l’image, puis Conserver. Les mesures centrales sont enregistrées à côté du masque ; les pixels centraux partagés appartiennent à une seule étiquette. Min area est ignoré.

records.key: Save an edited mask before Discard, Next or Previous; Keep always saves. If saving fails, stay on this image without recording a verdict. Off by default; Skip still writes no mask.
records.source: Save an edited mask before Discard, Next or Previous; Keep always saves. If saving fails, stay on this image without recording a verdict. Off by default; Skip still writes no mask.
records.translation: Enregistre un masque modifié avant Éliminer, Suivant ou Précédent ; Conserver enregistre toujours. Si l’enregistrement échoue, reste sur cette image sans enregistrer de verdict. Désactivé par défaut ; Passer n’écrit toujours aucun masque.

records.key: Save this field's mask, mark the field as one to keep and move to the next. The verdict is written to csv/keep_discard.csv beside the images, with the image, its mask and the number of objects the mask holds right now.
records.source: Save this field's mask, mark the field as one to keep and move to the next. The verdict is written to csv/keep_discard.csv beside the images, with the image, its mask and the number of objects the mask holds right now.
records.translation: Enregistre le masque de ce champ, marque le champ comme à conserver et passe au suivant. La décision est enregistrée dans csv/keep_discard.csv à côté des images, avec l'image, son masque et le nombre d'objets actuellement contenus dans le masque.

records.key: The arrow offers Save mask and stay (Ctrl+S), Save on navigation, Upload data, Hide judged fields, First unreviewed and Blind.
records.source: The arrow offers Save mask and stay (Ctrl+S), Save on navigation, Upload data, Hide judged fields, First unreviewed and Blind.
records.translation: La flèche propose Enregistrer le masque et rester (Ctrl+S), Enregistrer en naviguant, Téléverser des données, Masquer les champs évalués, Première non examinée et En aveugle.
